recent-developments.text: In April 2026, the Company completed concurrent registered and private placement offerings, issuing an aggregate of 1,114,984 shares of common stock, pre-funded warrants exercisable for 696,866 shares (exercise price $0.001; exercised in full during the fiscal year for aggregate proceeds of $697), Series A-1 warrants exercisable for 1,811,850 shares (exercise price $1.435; five-year term), Series A-2 warrants exercisable for 1,811,850 shares (exercise price $1.435; 18-month term), and placement agent warrants exercisable for 97,561 shares (exercise price $1.7938; five-year term). Aggregate gross proceeds were approximately $2.6 million, of which approximately $0.6 million was invested in a concurrent insider-led private placement by two members of the Company’s Board of Directors on the same economic terms as unaffiliated investors in the concurrent private placement (see Note 9, Related Party Transactions). The Series A-1 and Series A-2 warrants became exercisable upon stockholder approval obtained on July 13, 2026 (see Note 10, Subsequent Events); the pre-funded warrants and placement agent warrants have been exercisable since issuance. All outstanding warrants are classified as equity in accordance with ASC 480 and ASC 815-40. The material terms of the warrants are set forth in the warrant agreements filed as Exhibits 4.1 through 4.4 to the Company’s Current Report on Form

The Series A-1, Series A-2, Pre-Funded, and Placement Agent Warrants were issued in the Company’s April 28, 2026 registered direct offering, concurrent private placement, and insider-led private placement (collectively, the “April 2026 Offerings”). See Note 4 (Common Stock), Note 9 (Related Party Transactions), and Note 10 (Subsequent Events).

In November 2023, the FASB issued ASU 2023-07, Segment Reporting (Topic 280): Improvements to Reportable Segment Disclosures, which requires enhanced disclosures about significant segment expenses and other segment items. The Company adopted these standards for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. The adoption of these standards affected the Company’s disclosures only and did not have a material impact on its financial position, results of operations, or cash flows.
